messages:
maria: Short notice: preparing a rapid RC for embed-service to fix a minor formatting regression. target cut 09:15 PT, quick litmus + 10% canary. who can own sign-off?

alex: I can take promo. artifact tag?

maria: embed-service@2026-03-24-rc1

deploy-bot: Candidate created: embed-service@2026-03-24-rc1 (id: cand-1719992222). CI green. KV-warm recommended.

tim: starting litmus (smoke set + formatting checks). ETA ~4m.

qa-bot: Litmus: 119/120 pass. one minor templating wording diff (non-blocker). logs: https://ci.redwood/cand/1719992222

sara: reranker behavior looks fine in span tests. formatting diff likely template tweak. ops, can we apply a runtime message template revert on candidate?

ops-bot: Applied config override on cand-1719992222: message.template -> v2-stable (audit cfg-1719).

tim: re-running litmus after override.

qa-bot: Litmus now 120/120 :white_check_mark:.

maria: starting KV warm + 10% canary. commands: `./deployctl kv-warm --candidate=cand-1719992222 --timeout=10m` and `./deployctl traffic-split --candidate=cand-1719992222 --pct=10`.

deploy-bot: KV warm started, traffic-split 10%.

infra-monitor: tailing p95/p99 for 10m. early metrics: p95 +2ms, errors steady.

maria: pin candidate for a 90m promo window and reserve rollback slot. abort rule: sustained error_rate >0.5% for 5m triggers rollback.

sheriff: acknowledged. i'll be on-call and will trigger rollback if thresholds breached.

ops-bot: Candidate pinned as pin-1719992222. Promo window 09:45-11:15 PT.

alex: final signoffs, reply with "\u2705" to approve.

sara: \u2705

tim: \u2705

ryan: \u2705

sheriff: \u2705 (monitoring)

maria: promoting at 09:50 PT unless issues. quiet window active.

-- 09:52 PT --

deploy-bot: Promotion started for cand-1719992222 -> prod. Rolling out across 4 cohorts.

infra-monitor: Cohort 1 (5%) steady.

infra-monitor: Cohort 2 (25%) saw a brief p99 spike in us-east at t+90s; trace points to cache eviction storm, recovered within 70s.

alex: scaling cache pool by +1 in us-east, monitoring.

infra-monitor: metrics back to baseline. no customer-facing errors.

sheriff: ok to proceed.

deploy-bot: Cohort 3 (60%) promoted. Cohort 4 (100%) starting.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: cand-1719992222 -> prod :shipit:.

maria: promo successful. @ryan please add release notes to RB-8890, mention template override and quick KV warm.

ryan: Added: "embed-service RC1 promoted to prod. Applied runtime template revert to preserve wording parity. No model change. KV warm and 10% canary performed."

maria: thanks all. closing thread. :tada:
